headline: Allcargo Global AGM concludes with all resolutions approved
summary: Allcargo Global Limited held its 3rd Annual General Meeting on September 22, 2026. Shareholders approved all eight resolutions, including financial statements adoption and borrowing limit increases.

headline: Manglam Infra wins Rs 0.96 Cr consultancy order from MPRRDA
summary: Manglam Infra & Engineering secured a Rs 0.96 crore consultancy order from MPRRDA for bridge projects. This adds to Q2FY27 inflows, though TTM revenue data is unavailable.

headline: Mayasheel wins Rs 38.23 Cr order from GNIDA
summary: Mayasheel Ventures secures Rs 38.23 crore work order from Greater Noida Industrial Development Authority for RCC drain construction. This significant contract bolsters the SME's order book, contrasting with prior quarter inflows.

headline: HUDCO promoter stake consolidated under MoHUA
summary: HUDCO discloses transfer of 20.73% promoter shares from Ministry of Rural Development to MoHUA. Total government holding remains 75%, with MoHUA now holding entire stake.
